title: Time to brute-force an 8-character full-complexity password
notes: Hive Systems' annual benchmark: time to brute-force a randomly generated 8-character password (numbers, upper/lower case, symbols) hashed with bcrypt (work factor 10), against a rented GPU fleet (16x RTX 5090 in the 2026 edition). Measured on the same standard across all three editions: 225 years (2024), 164 years (2025), 132 years (2026).
